# Kawaijs Docs - Learn by Playing

> Kawaijs is an open-source, web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py. Write indentation-based .kawa scripts, preview with kawa dev, try the browser playground, and build a static dist/ for GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, or itch.io. Includes save/load, backlog, rollback, PWA, i18n, and built-in SEO (Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt). kawa build validates labels and hotspots; StoryVM.getState() returns a safe clone. Created by Biagio Scaglia. MIT licensed.

Author: Biagio Scaglia
Engine: Kawaijs — web-native visual novel engine (TypeScript, Ren'Py-inspired scripting).
License: MIT

## Primary
- [Kawaijs Docs - Learn by Playing](https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/KawaiJS/): Interactive documentation / playable site

## Facts
- Kawaijs runs visual novels entirely in the browser with no backend required.
- Authors write `.kawa` scripts (indentation-based) and ship a static `dist/` folder.
- Deploy targets include GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, and itch.io.
- Built-in features: save/load, backlog, rollback, PWA, SEO meta, JSON-LD, i18n.
- `kawa build` compiles and runs semantic validation (labels, choices, hotspots).
- `StoryVM.getState()` returns a clone; mutating it does not alter the running story.
- Modals restore keyboard focus on Escape; `input` prompts cannot be dismissed with Escape.

## FAQ
- Q: What is Kawaijs?
  A: Kawaijs is a web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py. It lets you write .kawa scripts and ship a static site that runs in any modern browser.
- Q: Who created Kawaijs?
  A: Kawaijs was created by Biagio Scaglia. It is open source under the MIT license on GitHub.
- Q: How do I start a Kawaijs project?
  A: Run npx kawa create my-novel, then npx kawa dev to preview with live reload, and npx kawa build to export a dist/ folder.
- Q: Can I deploy a Kawaijs novel to GitHub Pages?
  A: Yes. kawa build produces a static dist/ with index.html, assets, PWA files, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt - ready for GitHub Pages or any static host.
- Q: Does Kawaijs support SEO?
  A: Yes. kawa.config.json configures author, description, keywords, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD (including FAQPage), favicon, sitemap, and llms.txt for search and answer engines.
- Q: Is Kawaijs free?
  A: Yes. Kawaijs is free and open source under the MIT license.
- Q: How do I deep-link into a lesson or scene?
  A: Use ?at=label (or ?label=) on the URL. Embed with ?embed=1. Restore shared progress with ?continue=token.
